label: Something other than the meditator is IN_ACT_4 in INFINITE_3, from the idea of it (inference)
rule: Existential instantiation, universal instantiation, and distinctness by a property one side lacks
meaning: The idea-of-the-infinite argument over one grades frame and one idea frame (analyst reconstruction; navigation: Descartes, Meditation III). P1 gives an occurring idea e of the infinite borne by the meditator. P2 gives a cause c of e's representing the infinite. Objective adequacy puts c in act in the infinite (IN_ACT_4, formally or eminently). The meditator is not in act in the infinite (P4), so c is not the meditator. The comparator also checks a finite interpretation on which all four premises hold together. All premises stay open. Objective adequacy is a separate premise, not an instance of formal containment (see the separation control). The conclusion says nothing of maximality, uniqueness or GOD_4.
